reference: While the chain was swinging, he pushed the bag into place.
sk: Kým sa reťaz kývala, dotlačil vrece na miesto.
cz: Zatímco se řetěz houpal, dotlačil pytel na místo.
acceptable: {While|As} the chain was swinging, he {pushed|shoved} the {bag|sack} {into place|into position}.
He {pushed|shoved} the {bag|sack} {into place|into position} {while|as} the chain was swinging.

mistakes.text: While the chain swung, he pushed the {bag|sack} into place.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri „while“ je pre dlhší prebiehajúci dej prirodzenejší Past Continuous: „was swinging“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U „while“ je pro delší probíhající děj přirozenější Past Continuous: „was swinging“.
mistakes.feedback_en: With “while”, Past Continuous is more natural for the longer background action: “was swinging”.

mistakes.text: While the chain was swinging, he was pushing the {bag|sack} into place.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dotlačenie na miesto je dokončený dej, preto Past Simple: „pushed“, nie „was pushing“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Dotlačení na místo je dokončený děj, proto Past Simple: „pushed“, ne „was pushing“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Pushing it into place is a completed action, so use Past Simple: “pushed”, not “was pushing”.

mistakes.text: While the chain was swinging, he pushed the {bag|sack} {on place|to the place|on the place}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Na miesto“ sa po anglicky povie „into place“.

mistakes.text: While the chain swinging, he pushed the {bag|sack} into place.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba „was“: Past Continuous sa tvorí „was“ + -ing, teda „was swinging“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí „was“: Past Continuous se tvoří „was“ + -ing, tedy „was swinging“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “was” is missing: Past Continuous is “was” + -ing, so “was swinging”.

mistakes.text: While the chain was swinging, he pushed {bag|sack} into place.
